new_roles.description:
**Posting End Date:**

November 19, 2026

**Employee Type:**

Regular-Full time

**Union/Non:**

This is a non-union position

As Plant Manager at the Easter location, you will play a pivotal leadership role in ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Enbridge’s Easter Wind facility. As the senior Enbridge representative on site, you will be accountable for the overall performance of the plant, balancing operational excellence with a strong commitment to safety, environmental stewardship, and regulatory compliance. You will lead day-to-day operations while fostering a positive, inclusive, and safety-first culture aligned with Enbridge’s values and expectations.

 

In this role, you will work collaboratively with internal teams, contractors, service providers, and community stakeholders to deliver strong operational and financial results. You will provide hands-on leadership across operations, maintenance, asset integrity, and compliance, while maintaining financial discipline and transparency. If you are an experienced leader who thrives in a dynamic operational environment, values continuous improvement, and takes pride in enabling reliable renewable energy production, apply today. #joinourteam

 

**What You Will Do**

* Lead safe and reliable operations by managing all operational and maintenance activities for wind turbines and Balance of Plant (BOP) assets, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., NERC, CIP, FAA) and Enbridge safety standards.

* Champion a strong safety culture by ensuring adherence to safety policies and procedures, overseeing contractor and partner performance, and ensuring timely and accurate reporting and investigation of safety incidents and metrics.

* Manage people and contractors on site, including daily supervision, site orientations, performance oversight, and effective engagement with service providers, landowners, and internal stakeholders.

* Execute asset maintenance and integrity plans, ensuring all preventive, corrective, and major maintenance activities are planned, scheduled, tracked, and completed to Enbridge standards using systems such as MAXIMO.

* Oversee compliance and operational excellence, conducting audits, monitoring performance, managing lost production, and proactively addressing operational issues in collaboration with operations, engineering, and asset management teams.

* Drive financial performance and accountability by developing and managing the facility’s budget, forecasts, P&L reporting, explaining variances, managing procurement and work orders, and identifying opportunities for cost optimization and efficiency.

Provide clear reporting and leadership visibility, delivering accurate facility performance, safety, environmental, and financial reporting, and representing Enbridge as a trusted, responsible partner in the operation of the facility. 

 

**What you bring:**

* Related university degree and seven-plus years’ experience OR nine ‐ plus years of previous field operations experience, OR equivalent mix of formal education and experience.

* Valid Driver’s License and ability to obtain a Passport.

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience including 3 years in a supervisory or management role.

* Strong electrical systems knowledge preferred, with ability to troubleshoot SCADA, substations, collection systems, and met towers; wind generation plant experience considered an asset.

* Demonstrated commitment to safety, ability to perform calmly under pressure, and strong problem‑solving and decision‑making capability.

* Proven people leadership, contract administration experience, and ability to build effective relationships with employees, contractors, landowners, municipalities, and community stakeholders.

Strong communication and integrity, customer-focused mindset, willingness to learn Enbridge systems and processes, and digital proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel) and Oracle. 

 

**Working Conditions:**

* This role will require being on-call (24/7) to respond to emergencies and/or maintenance needs of the site (on a pre-determined, scheduled basis).

* Plant Manager must reside within 75 miles of the site due to on-call requirements.

Travel may be required from time to time both within the United States and Canada (approximately 10-20%) 

 

The successful candidate will undergo various background screening that includes but is not limited to a 5-year driving record, criminal check, a company sponsored medical and drug testing.

 

**Physical Requirements:**

Must meet requirements of fit for work which includes, but is not limited to, demonstrating hand, arm, back and leg coordination needed to ascend and descend a wind tower and comply with a weight restriction of 132 kg (or 290lb) total climbing weight. Comfort with completing physically demanding tasks in all weather conditions and comfort working in enclosed spaces and at heights of 300 ft. Employee understands that these requirements may be modified at the Company's discretion.

Grasping, kneeling, light – moderate lifting (objects up to 45 pounds), reaching above shoulder, repetitive motion, sitting, standing, visual requirement (able to see screens, detect color coding, read fine print), hearing requirement.

 

**Mental Requirements:**

Ability to: understand, remember and apply oral and/or written instructions or other information, understand sophisticated problems and collaborate/explore alternative solutions, organize thoughts and ideas into understandable terminology, coordinate and prioritize work schedule on a short-term basis, make decisions which have moderate impact on the immediate work unit and monitor impact outside this area, understand and follow basic instructions and guidelines, complete routine forms, compose letters, outlines, memoranda and basic reports and connect with individuals via telephone.

 

**Base Salary:**

* Base salary ranges from $120,000 – $135,000 USD for US locations based upon candidate’s experience, skills, and internal equity.

Applicable compensation policies and guidelines apply to internal candidates. 

 

**Benefits:**

* A flexible benefits program that allows each employee to select the level of coverage needed for their family in the areas of health, dental, insurance, and disability.

* A paid maternity and parental leave benefit that offers up to 20 weeks of paid leave for birth-giving parents and up to 12 weeks for other eligible parents, providing flexibility and support during this important life event.

* Valuable retirement savings plans, including a savings plan with company stock as an investment option.

* Paid time off/vacation/sick, plus paid personal days off (depending on location), and paid holidays.

* An Employee and Family Assistance Program.

A Wellness Program, which focuses on supporting healthier employees by providing tools, resources, and opportunities to improve physical, mental, social, and financial well-being. 

 

***Company paid international relocation assistance is not offered for this role.***

Location:

Horsham, PA, US, 19044

Business Unit: Sensor, Test & Calibration

Job Description:

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all daily operations of the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, high-quality, and cost-effective production. This role oversees production, safety, quality, maintenance, shipping, warehousing, staffing, budgeting, and continuous improvement while supporting company goals, customer requirements, and regulatory compliance.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**

Facility & Maintenance

* Responsible for leading maintenance, facilities upkeep, asset reliability, and repair operations within plant.
* Respond to emergency repair situations and provide leadership for urgent maintenance needs, including factory visits when required.
* Ensures that production equipment, building systems, utilities, and facility infrastructure operate safely, efficiently, and reliably.
* Oversee preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs for production equipment, heavy machinery, manufacturing utilities, and facility systems.
* Develop and manage maintenance schedules to reduce machine downtime, improve reliability, and extend equipment life.
* Inspect facilities, equipment, and infrastructure regularly to identify issues early and ensure timely corrective action.
* Coordinate repair and maintenance projects involving mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire suppression, security, lifts, cranes, and general building systems.
* Implement and enforce workplace safety policies and standards, including electrical safety, lockout/tagout, fire safety, hot work, and related compliance requirements.
* Lead root-cause analysis investigations for equipment failures and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Supervise mechanical and electrical technicians, assign work, monitor performance, and support training and skill development.
* Source, coordinate, and oversee external contractors and vendors, including service-level agreements and project execution.

Operational Leadership:

* Direct and manage daily plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, shipping, warehousing, and support functions.
* Ensure production schedules, shipment commitments, and customer requirements are met safely, efficiently, and on time.
* Enforce company safety policies, OSHA requirements, environmental procedures, and regulatory standards to maintain a safe workplace.
* Lead, coach, train, and develop employees/ team while promoting accountability, teamwork, and employee engagement.
* Manage labor, materials, equipment, and operating expenses to meet cost, productivity, and business objectives.
* Support operational planning, capital improvement recommendations, staffing plans, and business growth initiatives.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in Lean Manufacturing, a commitment to developing people, and a passion for operational excellence.

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Business, Operations Management or a related field. (Master’s preferred). Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or similar experience preferred.

Brings strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, along with the ability to lead through influence, set clear expectations, and hold teams accountable. Deep knowledge of manufacturing processes, safety regulations, and quality systems, with a consistent focus on driving operational excellence. Experienced in identifying process improvement opportunities and implementing safer, more efficient practices across operations. Demonstrated success in managing, mentoring, and developing high-performing teams, and skilled in using the Choosing By Advantages (CBA) decision-making methodology. **Job Posting End Date**

11-15-2026

Please note the job posting will close on the day before the posting end date.

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager will direct the activities of the plant employees in a safe, compliant, reliable, and economical manner including electric power production, maintenance, engineering, construction, accounting, procurement, materials management, human resources, public affairs, tax matters and compliance with regulating agencies. Responsible for establishing and maintaining two-way communications with employees, managers and the general public. Provide leadership and manage change by the development of a culture that promotes/supports teamwork, process improvement activities, employee development, and proper recognition and reward.

**Job Description**

**What You'll Do:**

 

* Plan, organize, coordinate, direct and control plant activities including the operation, maintenance, engineering and construction of the plant's facilities in a safe, efficient and economical manner.
* Support the System Safety Process. Develop, maintain and enforce safe working conditions by providing proper and adequate tools, equipment, protective clothing and devices, and training. Establish and enforce safe work behaviors. Participate in the setting of safety goals for an accident-free work environment. Communicate to employees about the importance of a safe work environment on a daily basis. Investigate, report and track incidents/accidents including root cause analysis and corrective action taken. Report findings to management and to employees.
* Develop long range plans for maintenance and operational excellence, capital improvements, equipment availability, cultural transformation, and the plant organization's succession planning requirements.
* Direct long range planning activities including maintenance management, materials management, QA/QC, human resources, accounting, predictive and preventative maintenance systems, and public relations.
* Develop short range (three years to coincide with the investment review committee) plan and forecasts in cooperation with engineering and maintenance personnel; develop budgets, prepare variance reports and control expenditures to meet approved budgets.
* Direct the operation of plant activities to ensure compliance with all local, state and federal laws and regulations and compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Participate in the formulation of company policies and procedures pertaining to plant operations.
* Establish and maintain close liaison with city, county, local and other officials and industrial leaders, and inform appropriate persons of actions, proposals and plans that have a bearing on plant operations and activities.

**What We're Looking For:**

Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, business management; or associate degree in a technical field, chemistry, environmental services, accounting, or equivalent applied knowledge (see experience).

Experience: Minimum of 8 years' experience including work in plant operations, maintenance, and performance areas. Experience should include business/financial and human resources administration. A minimum of eight years supervising others. OTHER REQUIREMENTS: Physical demand level is Sedentary.

Training should include company courses in leadership, supervision, change-management, team skills, problem solving & decision making, process improvement, safety, business skills and other relevant courses.

**What You’ll Get:**

In addition to a competitive compensation, AEP offers a unique comprehensive benefits package that aims to support and enhance the overall well-being of our employees.

**Where Putting the Customer First Powers Everything We Do!**

At AEP, we’re more than just an energy company — we’re a team of dedicated professionals committed to delivering safe, reliable, and innovative energy solutions. Guided by our mission to put the customer first, we strive to exceed expectations by listening, responding, and continuously improving the way we serve our communities. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact and being part of a forward-thinking organization, this is the company for you!

R10104082 Plant Manager (Open)

Location:

Carnegie, PA

**How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW?**
-------------------------------------

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces the unique perspectives of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders, and cultures across the world. We believe that a variety of backgrounds makes our team stronger and more innovative.

**At Airgas, we RESPECT, HONOR and VALUE diversity.**
=====================================================

 

**Airgas is Hiring for a Plant Manager in Carnegie, PA**
========================================================

 

***We are looking for you !***

 

* **Comprehensive Family Benefits:** Airgas offers a full benefits package designed to support your whole life, including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance.
* **Support for Parents:** We offer a 14-week paid child birth benefit to support growing families.
* **Future Security:** 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, Tuition Assistance, Paid Holidays, Vacation, and Sick time.
* **Early Access:** Your benefits start after just 30 days of employment.

 

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading and empowering the team engaged in producing and repackaging of compressed and liquid gases into cylinders, correcting unsafe acts or conditions without delay, and aligning daily responsibilities with team members according to customer needs, current stock levels and team strengths.

* Ensures the safe operation and maintenance of the plant for pumping or repackaging of gases into cylinders while ensuring compliance with all federal, state, local and company policies, procedures, regulations and laws. Maintains a neat, clean and orderly plant appearance.
* Studies production schedules and estimates team-hour requirements for completion of job assignments. Establishes and/or adjusts work procedures collaboratively to meet production schedules.
* Partners with the team to enhance production methods, equipment performance, and product quality. Adapts workflows and use of equipment to support team productivity and well-being.
* Ensures all safety rules are strictly observed and safety training is regularly scheduled, conducted and documented. Interpret company policies to team members and foster a culture of safety adherence.
* Ensures all injuries and accidents are properly investigated and reported within 24 hours.
* Analyzes and resolves, or partners with team members in solving, work related problems. Supports career growth, internal movement, and constructive performance management. Ensures associate issues, grievances, etc. are effectively handled.
* Mentors and guides operational leaders to cultivate effective leadership. Design collaborative initiatives to inspire and engage the team to achieve goals. Provides coaching and corrective action promptly, to ensure that team members receiving feedback are supported to meet shared performance goals.
* Onboards new team members and supports cross-functional learning to continue production during personnel shortages.
* Maintains time and production records and approves overtime when essential, while keeping overtime at acceptable levels.
* Collaborates with outside sales to ensure order accuracy and properly scheduled customer deliveries by Airgas trucks.
* Monitors SAP reports daily such as open order/delivery reports, billing and delivery block reports and open Purchase Order (PO) reports.
* Oversees employee development in procedural areas such as following all Airgas Standard Operating Procedures (SOPS) and safety regulations.
* Run recurring orders for the next day's deliveries.
* Route all the trucks and PGI tickets.
* Complete Daily Cycle Counts.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
----------------------------------------------------

**Are you a MATCH?**
--------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or GED
* A total of five (5) years of industry experience to include a minimum of two (2) years of demonstrated experience working in a supervisory/leadership role. Prefer prior experience with compressed/packaged gases.

**Prefered Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree
* Prior experience utilizing SAP preferred.
* Intermediate knowledge of Google suite applications
* Strong analytical skills and a thorough understanding of how to leverage metrics and related tools to improve production efficiency and effectiveness.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. Communication skills that ensure a smooth flow of information between self and others through clear speaking and writing, encouragement of open expression of ideas, and effective listening.

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to deal effectively with others in both favorable and unfavorable situations regardless of status of position. Accepts cultural diversity and establishes effective working relationships.
* Demonstrated knowledge of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division in all units of measure using whole numbers, fractions and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratios, and percent.

* Lives by Airgas safety programs, OSHA, and all related rules, regulations, procedures which are applicable to this position’s responsibilities

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Benefits**

We care about and support our Airgas Families. This is evident not only through our competitive compensation but also through a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision plans, short-term and long-term disability, life and accidental death and dismemberment (AD&D) insurance, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), pre-tax commuter transportation benefit, parental leave, vacation, sick time, floating holidays, jury duty and funeral/bereavement leave, and paid holidays for all eligible full-time employees.

Additionally, we offer our eligible employees a 401k plan with company matching funds, tuition reimbursement, discounted college tuition for eligible employees’ dependents, and an Airgas Scholarship Program for dependent children.

Associates who are members of collective bargaining units should review their bargaining agreement to determine whether they are eligible for some or all of the benefits described here and to see any special terms or conditions for eligibility.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Your DIFFERENCES enhance our PERFORMANCE**

At Airgas, we are committed to building a workplace that embraces the diversity of our employees, our customers, patients, community stakeholders and cultures across the world.

We welcome and consider applications from all qualified applicants, regardless of their race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability or any other protected characteristic. We strongly believe a diverse organization opens up opportunities for people to express their talent, both individually and collectively and it helps foster our ability to innovate by living our fundamentals, acting for our success and creating an engaging environment in a changing world.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**About Airgas**

Airgas, an Air Liquide company, is a leading U.S. supplier of industrial, medical and specialty gases, as well as hardgoods and related products; one of the largest U.S. suppliers of safety products; and a leading U.S. supplier of ammonia products and process chemicals. Through the passion and diversity of its 18,000 associates, Airgas fosters a culture of safety, customer success, sustainability and innovation. Airgas associates are empowered to share ideas, take initiative and make decisions.

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**
 
Amrize is building North America. From bridges and railways to data centers, schools, offices and homes, our solutions are inside the buildings and infrastructure that connect people and advance how we live. And we invite you to come and build with us.

As the partner of choice for professional builders, we offer advanced branded solutions from foundation to rooftop. Wherever our customers are, whatever their job, we’re ready to deliver. Our 19,000 colleagues work across 1,000 sites supported by an unparalleled distribution network. Infrastructure, commercial and residential, new build, repair and refurbishment: We’re in every construction market.

Amrize listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the SIX Swiss Exchange on June 23, 2025, following our spinoff as an independent company. Join us and build *your* ambition.

Description:

Join Amrize as a Plant Manager - Aggregate and help construct what's next. If you're ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America — we want to hear from you!

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The basic function of the Plant Manager is to provide the necessary leadership to plan, direct, organize, coordinate and control the mining of raw materials and the production of shippable product at the assigned Plant in a manner to meet Aggregate Dispatcher requests on a timely and cost efficient basis. The Plant Manager will be tasked with ensuring that an appropriate quality product is made at the Plant.

The Plant Manager will ensure proper staffing and monitoring of the inventory status at the Plant and in addition will coordinate activities with the following departments: Aggregate Operations Department - Dispatch, Maintenance, and Quality Control of the Region in addition Regional Administration/Financial function.

The Plant Manager will analyze and monitor production efficiency / productivity to ensure the Company is fully utilizing on site vehicles and plant equipment at the assigned location. In addition, the Plant Manager will develop mining and production strategies and tactics to ensure an approach to raise productivity levels, maintaining safety as a top propriety, while controlling the costs of the assigned location.

 

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Consistently identify new operational opportunities and develop strategies for accomplishing the attainment of improved efficiency and productivity.
* Address the needs of the customer while at the same time promoting and protecting the long-term interests of the Company.
* Initiate and implement production and scheduling related programs, strategies and techniques that result in increased productivity, and maintain safe operations of the assigned Plant, while containing the budgeted expenses of the assigned plants.
* Manage the performances of subordinate personnel, work independently, meet deadlines and manage the assigned Plant with fiscal integrity.
* Delegate responsibilities; must be able to objectively evaluate the performance of subordinates; and must be able to hold others accountable in a constructive manner.
* Participate in Company safety inspections.
* Communicate with site crew which includes plant operator, loader operators and laborers
* Supervise team to maintain production and efficiency. Schedule production and execute preventative maintenance routines
* Maintain sufficient inventory levels at site to service customers’ needs
* Coordinate safety issues and investigate incidents with safety department. Ensure environmental compliance, rehabilitation and meeting permit obligations
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree

**Field of Study Preferred:** Mining Engineering, Management
 
**Required Work Experience**: 5-7 years Aggregate Mining and related Raw Materials Plant Production experience

**Required Technical Skills:** Computer proficiency required. SAP experience would be a plus

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. Subject to applicable law, employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.
 

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Competitive salary
* Savings: Choose from 401(k) pre-tax and/or Roth after-tax savings
* Medical, Dental, Disability and Life Insurance
* Holistic Health & Well-being programs
* Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) & Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) for health and dependent care
* Vision and other Voluntary benefits and discounts
* Paid time off & paid holidays
* Paid Parental Leave (maternity & paternity)
* Educational Assistance Program
* Dress for your day

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

The Plant manager will provide leadership and direction to ensure the continual, efficient and uniform operation which will meet or exceed customer expectations in a safe and orderly manner.
 
He/she will develop and implement plans coordinated with the Corporate Business Plan to increase the reliability and continually improve the quality and efficiencies of the products and services provided by the business unit.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Supervise branch production using RMAS Warehouse Management System and available Production Planning tools
* Develop plans and procedures to insure the safety of all employees and visitors of the warehouse and Clarify and correct any incorrect warehouse procedures
* Ensure operations and equipment is in compliance to corporate guidelines and OSHA Standards
* Verify inventory and make adjustments where necessary
* Hire, train and motivate warehouse employees to build bench strength and increase retention by scheduling and provide training for growth and compliance
* Maintain equipment to provide maximum availability and minimum down time
* Evaluate and recommend new equipment purchases to enhance quality, capabilities and productivity
* Communicate and monitor progress towards company safety, returns and allowances, and on time shipment and delivery directives
* Responsible for building maintenance and security
* Monitor quality and process improvement throughout the warehouse using SAP reports
* Ensure that preventive and corrective action methods are followed to eliminate or correct procedures and practices which do not meet customer requirements
* Follow progressive disciplinary action to adhere to policy and procedures
* Ensure adequate support of the sales department and its customers in a timely and orderly manner
* Assist with customer problems, including on-site visits where necessary
* Facilitate Lean practices in the Plant
* Purchase or direct the purchase of necessary warehouse supplies to insure the ability to comply with written work instructions and customer requirements
* Attend regional and corporate meetings when required
* Perform employee reviews as required
* Assist in contract negotiations, where applicable
* This is a position that works directly on the warehouse floor on or around heavy machinery
* Meets TKMNA Employee Attributes/Competencies

The above is intended to describe the general content of and requirement for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements.

**This position has been identified as** **“safety sensitive”** **by thyssenkrupp under applicable laws. Accordingly, any application for this position that is considered for employment with thyssenkrupp requires successful completion of pre-employment drug testing, which may include testing for marijuana in accordance with any applicable federal, state, and local laws.**

**Qualifications:**

Minimum Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree preferred (in a Business, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and Behavioral Science curriculum)
* Two years direct Warehouse Supervision or team leadership, experience
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Office application, Excel, Word, Access and PowerPoint a must
* An understanding of Basic Lean Manufacturing Principles
* Safety Mindset

Preferred Requirements:

* MBA, Master’s degree or Ph.D. is a plus
* Exposure to labor relations, safety programs, ISO standards, Lean practices and sale functions.
* This individual must also possess good leadership qualities and the ability to build an effective team as well as be an effective team member

**Job Compensation**
--------------------

Up to $119K-$147K annually

**Benefits Overview**
---------------------

We offer competitive company benefits to eligible positions, such as:

* Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
* Life Insurance and Disability
* Voluntary Wellness Programs
* 401(k) or RRSP programs with Company Match
* Paid Vacation and Holidays
* Tuition Reimbursement
* And more!

*Benefits may vary based on job, country, union role, and/or company segment.* *Please work with your recruiter or tk representative for applicable benefits information.*

**Disclaimer**
--------------

This is to notify the general public that some individuals/entities are using the thyssenkrupp (“TK”) name, trademark, domain name, and logo without authorization. They are posing as employees, representatives, or agents of TK and its associated/group companies. These individuals/entities are fraudulently offering jobs online through texts, websites, telephone calls, emails, or by issuing fake offer letters. They are also soliciting jobseekers to deposit money in certain bank accounts or providing jobseekers with fraudulent checks to obtain banking information.

TK does not ask, solicit, or accept any monies in any form from candidates, job applicants, or potential jobseekers, who have applied to or wish to apply to TK, whether online or otherwise as a pre-employment requirement. TK bears no responsibility for money being deposited/withdrawn therefrom in response to such fake offers.

**Equal opportunity employer, including people with disabilities and veterans.**

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. For those requiring assistance completing the application or the application process and request information relating to the need for accommodation, please contact reasonableaccommodation@thyssenkrupp.com.

**TK does not:**

*1. Send job offers from free email services like Gmail, Rediffmail, Yahoo mail, etc.;* 
*2. Request payment of any kind from prospective jobseekers or candidates for employment;* 
*3. Authorize anyone to collect money or agree to any monetary arrangement in return for a job at TK;* 
*4. Send checks to job seekers; or* 
*5. Make job offers through third parties. In the event TK uses professional recruitment services through a third party, offers are always made directly by TK and not by any third parties.*

**PLEASE NOTE:**

*1. TK strongly recommends that potential jobseekers do not respond to such fake solicitations, in any manner;* 
*2. TK will not be responsible to anyone acting on an employment offer that is not directly made by TK;* 
*3. Anyone making an employment offer in return for money is not authorized by TK; and*

TK follows a formal recruitment process through its own HR department and applications are evaluated by its HR department through pre-defined processes. Please visit our official careers website at https://jobs.thyssenkrupp.com/en to view authentic job openings at TK.

If you receive any unauthorized, suspicious, or fraudulent offers or interview calls, please email us at tkmna.employee.care@thyssenkrupp-materials.com.

new_roles.title: Slag Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Line of Business: Cement & White

### **About Us**

Heidelberg Materials is one of the world's largest suppliers of building materials. Heidelberg Materials North America operates over 450 locations across the U.S. and Canada with approximately 9,000 employees.

 

The Plant Manager role is based at our slag grinding facility in Cape Canaveral, FL and reports directly to the Vice President of Cement Operations.

 

### **What You’ll Be Doing**

 

* Leads plant safety program to ensure a safe working environment. Ensures all company safety policies are implemented and followed.

* Actively participate in the development of the plant’s objectives and oversee all aspects of daily plant production and maintenance activities to optimize plant performance.

* Provide input into plant capital plan and operation plan and effectively manage budget costs.

* Plans, coordinates and directs all production activities to ensure that Plant Operations goals and targets are realized.

* Analyzes plant activities on a daily basis to assess and recommend areas for improvements in production, quality or efficiency.

* Synchronizes production activities with quarry, maintenance, process and quality control activities to make certain that the plant is performing to highest standards.

* Manages the team to ensure production requirements are met.

* Oversee plant maintenance.

* Ensure that the maintenance and operation of equipment is at optimal levels.

* Guides and directs maintenance managers to minimize equipment downtime.

* Plans, organizes and oversees the annual plant shut down.

* Ensures HTC Maintenance initiatives are implemented.

* Leads and fosters the collaborative efforts of the plant staff to address operating methods, procedures, and problems toward continuous improvement of production quality and efficiency. Identifies training needs of plant staff and ensures that appropriate training is implemented.

* Fully support the company’s purchasing initiative and ensure that purchasing policies and contract management policies and procedures are adhered to in the plant.

* Work in partnership with Plant Purchasing personnel regarding the purchase of major equipment.

* In collaboration with Sales and Marketing stay abreast of customer requirements and concerns.

* Determine and oversee the timely resolution to issues stemming from production, quality, etc.

* Participate in community activities to continually promote plant/community relations.

* Works with the plant Quality Control Department to meet product specifications and production goals

* Ensure compliance with plant policies & procedures, safety, environmental, state and federal process regulations.

* Ensure implementation of company policies and procedures.

* Responsible for the flawless execution of the Plant on call schedule, participating as needed.

* Leads and fosters the collaborative efforts of the plant staff to address operating methods, procedures, and problems toward continuous improvement of production quality and efficiency.

### **What Are We Looking For**

* A College Degree in Engineering or related field.

* 5 or more years progressive experience managing operations in a slag grinding facility

* Synchronize production activities with quarry, maintenance, process and quality control activities to make certain that the plant is performing to highest standards.

* Manage the team to ensure production requirements are met.

* Oversee plant maintenance.

* Ensure that the maintenance and operation of equipment is at optimal levels.

* Guide and direct maintenance manager to minimize equipment downtime.

* In coordination with Plant Management, plan, organizes and oversee the annual plant shut down.

* Ensure HTC Maintenance initiatives are implemented.

* A high level of technical knowledge related to all aspects of cement manufacturing

* Familiar with Central Control operations, including the process control system in a preheater plant with a pre-calciner and alternate fuels experience an asset.

* Managerial and leadership competencies acquired in progressively more responsible positions in a non-unionized plant with the ability to perform in roles of both plant manager and direct reports on a relief basis.

* Ability to make timely, critical decisions, often under conditions of uncertainty and stress.

* Detailed knowledge about process equipment interlocking; Knowledge in mill liner installation and ball charge design.

* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

* Proficient with windows-based PC software programs including MS Office, SAP and other applicable software programs.

* Ability to read and understand financial statements and cost reports, prepare budget and forecasts and to focus on and manage costs.

* Strong interpersonal, leadership and motivational skills.

* Ability to communicate effectively and interact as a team member in a Total Quality environment

### **What We Offer**

 

* Competitive base salary, $139,100 to $185,460 annually and participation in our annual incentive plan.
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with an automatic company contribution as well as matching contributions.
* Highly competitive benefits programs, including:

* + Medical, Dental, and Vision along with Prescription Drug Benefits
 + Health Savings Account (HSA), Health Reimbursement Account (HRA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
 + AD&D, Short- and Long-Term Disability Coverage as well as Basic Life Insurance
 + Paid Bonding Leave, 15 days of Paid Vacation, 40 hours of Paid Sick Leave and 10 Paid Holidays

Equal Opportunity Employer - Minority / Female / Veteran / Disabled.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Lead Operations. Build Teams. Drive Growth.**

Are you a hands-on operations leader who thrives on building high-performing teams, improving processes, and delivering results? UFP Factory Built is looking for a Plant Manager to lead one of our manufacturing facilities and play a key role in the success of our growing business.

 

As a Plant Manager, you'll have the opportunity to run the operation like it's your own, leading production, safety, quality, inventory, maintenance, and team development while making a direct impact on profitability and customer satisfaction. This is an ideal role for a leader who enjoys solving problems, developing people, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**About UFP Factory Built**

UFP Factory Built, a division of UFP Industries, supplies structural components and engineered solutions for manufactured housing, modular construction, RV, and cargo trailer manufacturers throughout North America. We are part of a stable, growth-oriented organization with a strong reputation for investing in our people and promoting from within.

 

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead all day-to-day plant operations, ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and profitability goals are achieved.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of supervisors and production employees.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, waste reduction, and efficiency initiatives.
* Manage production scheduling, inventory levels, shipping activities, and resource planning.
* Monitor key performance metrics and take action to improve throughput, quality, and financial results.
* Partner with leadership on capital investments, facility improvements, and business growth initiatives.
* Foster a culture centered around safety, employee engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, OSHA standards, and all applicable regulations.
Oversee maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime. 

 

### **What We're Looking For**

* Experience leading manufacturing, production, operations, or industrial teams.
* Proven ability to motivate employees, develop talent, and drive results.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing budgets, costs, and operational metrics.
* Ability to identify opportunities, solve problems, and implement effective solutions.
* Experience with inventory management, production scheduling, and process improvement.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Forklift certification or willingness to obtain certification. 

 

### **Why Join UFP?**

* Opportunity to lead and influence all aspects of a manufacturing operation.
* High visibility and direct impact on business performance.
* Stable and growing company with a strong national footprint.
* Collaborative culture that values leadership, innovation, and accountability.
* Career advancement opportunities within UFP Industries.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package. 

 

### **What Success Looks Like**

In this role, you'll build a safe, efficient, and engaged operation, develop future leaders, improve plant performance, and help position the facility for continued growth. You'll have the autonomy to make decisions, the support of an experienced leadership team, and the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on the business.

 

**If you're a driven operations leader looking to take ownership of a facility, develop teams, and grow your career with an industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.**

**Benefits** **currently offered to our employees:**

* Medical Insurance
* Health Savings Account with Company Contribution
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Paid Vacation and Holidays
* Stock Purchase Program with Employee Discount
* Education Reimbursement
* Wellness Programs and Challenges
Other Supplemental Benefits 

*The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 
 
DESCRIPTION: 
Join Thermo Fisher Scientific as a Senior Manager, Plant/Site and contribute to global science and healthcare. You'll oversee operations at advanced facilities, ensuring the delivery of high-quality products that help our customers make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. This leadership role involves advancing operational excellence through Lean manufacturing principles, managing cross-functional teams, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives. 
 
As the site leader, you'll be responsible for developing and executing strategic plans, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining strong customer relationships. You'll support our core values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation, and Involvement while cultivating a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence. This role offers the opportunity to implement positive change, support team development, and contribute to scientific advances. 
 
REQUIREMENTS: 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in operations leadership in sophisticated manufacturing environments
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering, Science, Business Management, or related field
* Strong track record implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies
* Experience leading teams in FDA-regulated, cGMP, ISO 13485, or similar quality systems
* Demonstrated financial acumen in budget management and operational cost control
* Excellence in developing and executing strategic and annual operating plans
* Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams in matrix organizations
* Strong project management skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives
* Experience with quality systems, regulatory compliance, and audit management
* Expert knowledge of operational KPIs and data-driven process improvement
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills across all organizational levels

* Proficiency in leading change management initiatives

* Experience of working in a unionized environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to travel up to 10-15% as required
* Experience maintaining safety programs and environmental compliance
* Excellent vendor and customer relationship management skills

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in Connecticut is $131,300.00–$205,000.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.title: Printing Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
**Work Location: Newington, CT. This is an in person role, not remote, not hybrid**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Work Schedule: Monday - Friday; 8:30 am - 5:00 pm**

**SUMMARY**
-----------

The Plant Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, management, and performance of the Data-Graphics manufacturing facility. This position directs all aspects of plant operations, including production, quality, safety, maintenance, staffing, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Plant Manager ensures production commitments are met while maintaining high quality standards, maximizing operational efficiency, controlling costs, and fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and safety.

The Plant Manager provides strategic and hands-on leadership to achieve key performance indicators (KPIs), customer satisfaction goals, employee engagement objectives, and business growth initiatives.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
=========================================

**Operations Management**

* Direct and oversee all day-to-day plant operations, including production, scheduling, quality, safety, maintenance and receiving activities.
* Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining quality standards, delivery commitments, and operational efficiency.
* Develop, monitor, and achieve plant performance metrics related to productivity, quality, waste reduction, safety, downtime, labor utilization, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with sales, customer service, prepress, and production teams to ensure customer expectations are consistently met or exceeded.
* Establish priorities and allocate resources to support production requirements and business objectives.
* Analyze operational performance and implement corrective actions as needed to improve productivity and profitability.

**Leadership & Employee Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop supervisors, and production personnel to maximize performance and engagement.
* Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, teamwork, professionalism, and employee development.
* Conduct performance evaluations, establish performance expectations, and provide ongoing coaching and feedback.
* Partner with Human Resources on workforce planning, employee relations matters, recruitment, retention, performance management, and disciplinary actions.
* Ensure employees receive appropriate training and development opportunities to support operational excellence.

**Quality Management**

* Champion quality initiatives to ensure products consistently meet customer specifications and company quality standards.
* Investigate quality concerns and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring issues.
* Monitor production processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and defect reduction.
* Work closely with client services and suppliers to address quality-related concerns and maintain strong business relationships.

**Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all company safety policies, environmental regulations, and applicable OSHA requirements.
* Promote and maintain a safe work environment through training, audits, inspections, and corrective actions.
* Conduct regular safety reviews and support accident investigation and root cause analysis activities.
* Ensure appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) is utilized and safety procedures are consistently followed.

**Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee preventive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, waste reduction, and cost-saving initiatives throughout the facility.
* Evaluate equipment, processes, and workflows to identify opportunities for increased efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve throughput, reduce spoilage, and optimize labor utilization.

**Financial Management**

* Develop and manage departmental budgets and operational expenses.
* Monitor labor costs, production costs, and capital expenditures to ensure financial targets are achieved.
* Participate in forecasting, strategic planning, and capital investment decisions affecting the facility.

**Communication & Reporting**

* Communicate operational results, goals, and key initiatives to leadership and employees.
* Prepare and present reports on plant performance, production metrics, quality trends, safety performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Keep executive management informed of significant operational issues, risks, and opportunities.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of company objectives.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of management experience overseeing production operations and employees.
* Printing, packaging, direct mail, graphic communications, or related manufacturing industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.
* Experience managing budgets, KPIs, production planning, and quality systems.

**COMPETENCIES**

**Leadership**

* Strong leadership and team-building abilities
* Ability to motivate and develop employees at all levels
* Effective coaching, mentoring, and performance management skills
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities

**Operational Excellence**

* Knowledge of manufacturing operations and process improvement methodologies
* Understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles
* Experience utilizing production metrics and KPIs to drive results
* Strong project management and organizational skills

**Technical Knowledge**

* Knowledge of printing operations, lithographic printing, flexographic printing, finishing, and mailing operations preferred
* Understanding of quality management systems and root cause analysis techniques
* Knowledge of maintenance planning and equipment reliability principles

**Communication & Business Skills**

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong analytical and financial acumen
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook
* Ability to effectively manage customer, vendor, and employee relationships

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
### **At Materion, everyone is included, respected and offered opportunity to grow.** ***Join us!***

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Operations, Premium Targets provides strategic and operational leadership for a complex, multi-site manufacturing organization with domestic and international operations. This leader is accountable for safety, quality, delivery, cost, customer performance, talent development, capital execution, and continuous improvement. The individual in this role will lead Operations, Supply Chain, and Engineering teams, including manufacturing facilities across multiple locations. As the organization’s senior operations safety leader, the Director sets clear expectations, models visible safety leadership, empowers employees to identify and address hazards, and holds leaders accountable for proactive risk reduction and continuous EHS improvement. Working across Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions, the Director translates business priorities into sustainable results, standardizes manufacturing and business processes, and delivers exceptional service to internal and external customers. The role also leads operations strategy and financial performance, including gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Operations Leadership and Execution**
=======================================

* Lead a proactive, prevention-focused safety culture in which every employee is empowered and expected to identify hazards, stop unsafe work, and take ownership of a safe and healthy workplace.
* Lead manufacturing operations across Buffalo, Wheatfield, Albuquerque, Limerick, and Brewster, with strong matrix partnerships supporting Alzenau and Taiwan.
* Own performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, and customer commitments; establish clear metrics, review performance routinely, and hold site leaders accountable for results.
* Set and execute the Premium Targets operations strategy, multi-year roadmap, and long-range capital and workforce plans.
* Ensure facilities consistently deliver high-quality products on time to internal business units and external customers.
* Partner with Technology, Quality, Supply Chain, Commercial, Engineering, EHS, and other functions to align priorities and improve end-to-end performance.
* Develop, coach, and hold operational leaders accountable for business results, team effectiveness, and talent growth.
* Strengthen communication, operating discipline, and knowledge sharing across all Premium Targets facilities.
* Provide clear, timely business updates and recommendations to senior leaders and key stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence, Strategy, and Capital Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Champion EHS excellence by ensuring regulatory compliance, audit readiness, effective risk assessments, timely incident and near-miss investigation, corrective-action closure, and consistent use of leading and lagging safety indicators.
* Serve as executive sponsor for the Premium Targets Lean manufacturing transformation.
* Advance daily management, structured problem solving, kaizen, standard work, process improvement, and cost-reduction practices across sites.
* Partner with Lean resources and site leaders to implement improvements and sustain measurable gains.
* Lead major capital programs, equipment installations, expansions, and facility transitions in partnership with Engineering, corporate, business-unit, and capital teams.
* Ensure capital initiatives meet approved cost, schedule, quality, and performance objectives while integrating safety into design, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Develop manufacturing and supply chain strategies that support production, maintenance, planning, EHS, technical capability, and customer requirements.
* Partner with Commercial teams to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
* Enable best-practice sharing and process standardization across manufacturing locations.
* Lead financial performance improvement, with a focus on gross margin, inventory turns, and cost management.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required Qualifications**

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Company Description**

At **Link Snacks**, we show up hungry, roll up our sleeves, plaid or otherwise, and dive straight into the hard work. We don’t hide from challenges; we hunt them down. We push harder, move faster, and take the kinds of big swings that built this business in the North Woods of Wisconsin four decades ago.

We’re everyday people who deliver extraordinary results. Innovation, creativity, and urgency aren’t buzzwords, they’re expectations. And just like the real protein snacks we make across our global house of brands—Jack Link’s®*,* Lorissa’s Kitchen®*,* Golden Island®*,* BiFi®*, and* Peperami® *and* KOOEE!® to name a few—there’s nothing artificial about us. What you see is exactly what you get: humble, gritty, passionate people who show up every day ready to not just be a participate in the meat snack industry that the Link Family created, but to move faster, innovate harder and keep raising the bar so high, the rest of the world needs a ladder just to see it.

Dominating this space across the world takes a team. A team that runs together, succeeds together, and celebrates together. A team that’s full of relentless energy and spirit that can only be fueled by one thing: a fist full of our delicious meat snacks.

Real Meat Protein. Real People. Real Results. THAT is Link Snacks.

 **Job Description**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Sr Director of Operational Excellence leads the company's continuous improvement strategy across all manufacturing sites. This role will build the process, capabilities, tools, and governance necessary to create a consistent and sustainable approach to continuous improvement across all factories. The Sr Director will establish a standardized manufacturing excellence framework grounded in lean principles, structured problem solving, loss elimination, standard work, and performance management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the CI change effort. Develop and lead the company’s Continuous Improvement strategy and roadmap across all factories.
* Establish a common CI methodology, tools, governance, terminology, and expectations across the manufacturing network.
* Establish common standards for Lean practices, structured problem solving, daily management, standard work, and performance improvement.
* Establish and advance Lean manufacturing practices including standard work, Kaizen, 5S, value-stream mapping, visual management, root-cause analysis, waste elimination, centerlining, and structured problem solving.
* Develop CI training, tools, playbooks and learning programs.
* Develop a network of plant-level Continuous Improvement champions to accelerate adoption and share knowledge.
* Manage performance. Work with the Plant Leadership Team to track plant targets and KPIs regularly and set action plans and follow-up meetings to close gaps.
* Own KPI visibility. Manage the daily, weekly, and monthly KPI charting and posting process to keep teams accountable.
* Simplify data. Use Power BI and SAP to turn complex operational data into clear, usable information for plant and operations leaders.
* Apply analytics. Use statistics and other analytical methods to identify improvement opportunities and support decisions.
* Track savings. Implement and manage a cost savings tracking process aligned with corporate standards and deliver against savings targets.
* Partner on safety. Partner with the Safety Director to embed safety into improvement work, including incident investigation, hazard reduction, and safety considerations in kaizen events.
* Perform other duties as assigned

 
**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in operations, manufacturing, supply chain, business, engineering, food science, or related field, or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
* 7 to 10 years experience in a manufacturing environment, including a leadership role.
* 5+ years in influencing roles, such as CI, Lean, or support functions.
* Experience or education in statistical process control, root cause analysis, or other analytical methods.
* Training and hands-on experience with value stream mapping, kaizen methods, 5S, leader standard work, and other Lean tools.
* Project management experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver on timelines, budgets, and goals.
* Experience developing or implementing a playbook for a management operating system (MOS) and a continuous improvement program, including how the playbook was rolled out across sites.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SAP and Power BI for operational reporting.
* Experience in food or consumer packaged goods manufacturing.
* Experience with Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), with at least working exposure to its Autonomous Maintenance (AM) and Planned Maintenance (PM) pillars.

**Skill and Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence leaders at every level.
* Diplomacy in communicating needs and recommendations, with credibility that earns trust across functions.
* A proactive style that drives projects to completion despite obstacles.
* A collaborative team approach in all situations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams at once.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

 **Additional Information**

*The salary range for this role is $195,000 - 225,000 annually*

Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Employer** 
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

new_roles.description:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.

At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager, Factory Engineering position is responsible for managing the engineering activities relating to the factory and provide professional engineering and strategic technical leadership in the Factory, ensuring people health and safety, product safety and environment are never compromised. Strategic leader for engineering function, leveraging Nestle’s leadership principles in the following areas; capital execution, asset maintenance and utilities excellence, engineering compliance, and sustainability.

**JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Define and propose the Factory Engineering team’s plans and objectives, and monitor their implementation in accordance with the Engineering Policy, Key Principles, and Key Engineering Activities outlined in the Nestlé Engineering Excellence (NEE) master document.
* Live Nestle leadership principles in all aspects of the role.
* Set the technical strategic vision for the factory, leveraging other functional leaders and cascade objectives to all leaders in engineering department, within factory cost targets.
* Develop and maintain technical competencies at the factory, including detailed action plans, accountability to progress, talent review, career and succession planning.
* Drive equipment reliability through implementing maintenance foundations in TPM.
* Build cooperation and collaboration with the production and other cross functional teams to build world class operation.
* Improve maintenance cost structure by improving technical skill sets and optimizing 3rd party spend.
* Implement Nestle capital process to drive excellence in capital execution.
* Proactively develop, maintain and execute the capital market business strategy (MBS) to align with the business needs.
* Drive factory master planning to facilitate long term strategies across the factory for example in Safety, Quality and Warehouse.
* Ensure full compliance with all governing bodies for utilities system relevant to the Modesto site. This is paramount and non-negotiable to have strong understanding in these utilities systems.
* Maintain reliability through implementing maintenance foundations and TPM methodology.
* Develop and maintain all skillset necessary for internal management of utilities systems.
* Drive and execute plant sustainability objectives in line with market targets.
* Drive world class water management in the factory.
* Drive reliability in all electrical components in the factory.
* Ensure full compliance with Nestle standards including calibration.
* Develop technical skills in maintenance to ensure electrical reliability.
* Drive Innovation/Renovation, initiating/coordinating implementation of new processes/technology with relevant Market, Product Technology Center, Corporate and Strategic Business Unit.
* Cascade objectives to all leaders in alignment with factory objectives, and implement the strategic technical OMP and factory master plan.
* Develop a detailed cost management plan for all aspects of engineering, including year-over-year improvements.
* Develop a detailed action plan for all aspects of technical execution.
* Implement Maintenance Foundations and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) practices.
* Leverage corporate resources and ensure compliance with Nestlé Market standards.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s Degree (BA/BS) is required, preferably in Engineering, including Mechanical, Chemical, or Process. Experience would be considered in lieu of a degree.

**EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* At least 10 years of related work experience is highly preferred with at least 3+ years of leadership/management experience.
* Knowledge of food safety, regulatory requirements for food safety and hygienic engineering (OSH&R) preferred.
* Strong understanding of, or ability to learn, the full scope of role responsibilities, including financial analysis and key business drivers such as: Nestlé Standard Costing, Asset and Maintenance Management (AMM), CAPEX budgeting and preparation (CIAT), and Industrial Services/Energy Management (NEMT).
* Familiarity with TPM and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency with AutoCAD, Visio, CDM, AMM, ESAT, CIAT, NEMT and similar technical tools/systems.
* Demonstrated technical and managerial capabilities with in depth knowledge of food processing plant operations, technologies, utilities, maintenance systems, and hygienic engineering requirements (OSH&R).
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to apply root cause analysis and technical creativity to resolve complex short and long term issues.
* Effective communication and networking skills, with the ability to perform under pressure and in ambiguous environments.
* Experience in Project Engineering/Management, including plant design and construction.

Salary: $160,000.00 to $185,000.00 per year

Bonus Eligibility: Yes

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Flight Coordination Quality & Tr
new_roles.description:
**Title Options:** Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager

**Location:** Remote, US

**Reports to:** VP of Flight Coordination

**Hours:** Monday – Friday 8:30 am – 5:30 pm

**Position Summary**

The **Flight Coordination Quality & Training Manager** represents a quality-control and workforce-development function similar to those found in high-performing contact centers and service-delivery organizations. The role ensures every incoming lead, whether received by phone, web form, chat, or referral, is responded to promptly, handled consistently, accurately qualified, fully documented, and advanced through the appropriate next step. Through quality assurance, coaching, training, performance analytics, workflow oversight, and cross-functional coordination, this role strengthens Flight Coordinator performance while protecting the patient and partner experience from first contact through flight execution

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for continuously reviewing lead interactions, identifying performance and process gaps, and translating findings into targeted coaching, training, and development initiatives. The individual reviews call recordings, chats, web submissions, referral activity, CRM records, follow-up activity, and department handoffs to identify quality risks before they affect a patient, referring facility, payer, partner, or flight outcome.

**How this role impacts our mission**

Every day, families, healthcare providers, and case managers rely on our team to help navigate complex situations and coordinate critical air medical transportation. As the nation's largest fixed-wing air ambulance operator, our mission is to make those moments easier through compassionate, expert air medical transportation, connecting patients with the care they need and getting them to that destination.

The Flight Coordination team is often the first point of contact, serving as a trusted guide through a time-sensitive and highly emotional process. As the FC Quality & Training Manager, you will strengthen team performance through coaching, training, quality oversight, and continuous improvement – helping Flight Coordinators build the skills and confidence to deliver compassionate, accurate, and professional service while advancing opportunities efficiently and supporting patients throughout their journey.

This is an opportunity to shape the experience of both our team members and the families we serve. By improving quality, readiness, and operational consistency, you will help ensure that every patient, provider, and referral partner receives the highest level of care and support throughout their journey.

**Core ownership**

Own quality control across every inbound lead channel and protect forward movement through two distinct stages: (1) incoming lead to qualified opportunity and (2) active opportunity to completed flight or a fully documented, supportable lost outcome.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**1. Intake Quality & Opportunity Readiness**

* Monitor incoming inquiry channels, queues, assignment, and response times to ensure every viable inquiry is acknowledged and actively worked within established service expectations.
* Review calls and transcripts for discovery, active listening, empathy, urgency recognition, value communication, objection handling, qualification, closing language, and clear next steps.
* Audit whether Flight Coordinators appropriately advance, nurture, close, or disqualify inquiries.

* Review inquiries marked false, invalid, duplicate, unqualified, or closed-lost. Challenge, reopen, or escalate records when the disposition is unsupported or a viable opportunity may have been missed.
* Identify conversion and process gaps by coordinator, source, payer type, referral source, service type, call scenario, shift, and funnel stage.
* Maintain a standardized intake-quality scorecard and documented expectations for what strong performance looks like.

**2. Flight Readiness & Coordination Oversight**

* Serves as a cross-departmental liaison with Clinical Operations and Revenue Cycle Management to confirm required clinical reviews, financial clearance, authorizations, documentation, and follow-through are progressing on time and that each opportunity is fully prepared to fly.
* Monitor active opportunities until they become completed flights or reach a documented and supportable lost outcome.
* Confirm each opportunity has a clear next action, responsible owner, due date, and follow-up plan.
* Audit records for required patient, clinical, financial, facility, authorization, payer, transportation, logistics, and operational information.
* Identify aging, stalled, inactive, or incomplete opportunities and intervene before the flight is delayed or lost.
* Ensure follow-up continues after an inquiry is advanced to an opportunity and that ownership does not stop at the initial commitment.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.

**Quality Review, Coaching & Development**

* Establish and maintain a consistent review methodology across inbound calls, outbound follow-up, quote conversations, high-urgency inquiries, lost-flight interactions, and other priority scenarios.
* Conduct recurring one-on-one coaching using specific examples from calls, transcripts, records, and workflow activity.
* Create documented coaching plans with clear behaviors, actions, due dates, and follow-up review.
* Recognize strong performance and share repeatable best practices across the team.
* Measure whether coaching produces sustained improvement and escalate recurring quality or workflow concerns to Flight Coordination leadership.
* Partner with leaders on focused development plans when additional support or accountability is needed.

**4. Training & Team Readiness**

* Translate quality findings into targeted training, refreshers, job aids, talk tracks, checklists, and scenario-based exercises.

* Identify recurring themes that require team-wide training rather than individual coaching.
* Coordinate subject-matter input from Revenue Cycle Management, Clinical Operations, Logistics, and other operational partners.
* Maintain current process guidance and a centralized source of truth for Flight Coordination expectations.
* Support new-hire onboarding, readiness reviews, and ongoing proficiency checks.
* Track training completion, understanding, and sustained application on the job.

**5. Cross-Functional Handoff Quality**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Flight Coordination and departments receiving or supporting active opportunities.
* Establish clear handoff reuirements, ownership expectations, and acceptance criteria with partner departments.
* Audit documentation and coordination steps for completeness before and after handoff.
* Strong ability to identify revenue and service leakage, determine root causes, and translate findings into corrective action.
